title: Playboy April 1984 Joan Collins Roy Scheider Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
description:
Playboy magazine, April 1984, original $3.00 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Playmate of the Month: Lesa Ann Pedriana.

Cover features: Playboy Interview - Joan Collins bares her mind; Roy Scheider on playing big-league ball; The Year in Music - how to dance like Michael Jackson; Playboy Guide to Men's Fashion.

Back cover: Marlboro cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
